notes.title: Patch Notes - GeoJelly Early Access Exit Celebration!
notes.content:
🍬🎮[b]Patch Notes - GeoJelly Early Access Exit Celebration![/b]🌍

[b]Dear GeoJelly Explorers,[/b]

We are thrilled to announce that GeoJelly is officially leaving its [b]Early Access phase[/b] and moving into a new chapter of exciting adventures! We want to express our deepest gratitude to all of you who have supported us through this journey. Your feedback, suggestions, and dedication have been invaluable, and we couldn't have done it without you.

Here's what's new in this momentous update:

[b]1. Restart Button:[/b]
Your voices have been heard, and we're pleased to introduce the long-awaited "Restart" button. Now, you can jump back into the action without missing a beat, making your gameplay experience smoother and more enjoyable.

[b]2. Dynamic Aimer:[/b]
To help you navigate the challenging terrain of GeoJelly, we've added a dynamic aimer to your character. You'll now have a clear view of where you'll land during the drop, making precision landings a breeze.

[b]3. Vibrant Main Menu:[/b]
We've revamped the main menu with a burst of color, bringing a fresh and inviting look to the game. Explore the options and dive into the world of GeoJelly with style!

[b]4. Easter Eggs and Achievements:[/b]
Get ready to embark on thrilling treasure hunts as we've hidden even more easter eggs throughout the game. Unlock an array of new achievements and show off your accomplishments to your fellow GeoJelly adventurers.

[b]5. Dialogue System, Characters and Cutscene:[/b]
Discover a more immersive gaming experience with the new dialogue system. Engage with a host of diverse characters that will guide you through the GeoJelly universe, adding depth to the storyline. We have also added a cutscene for the first level. 

[b]6. Tutorial Upgrades and Tips:[/b]
We've upgraded our tutorial to ensure that players of all levels can get a grip on the game mechanics. We've also sprinkled in more helpful tips throughout your journey to assist you in mastering the GeoJelly universe.

[b]Other updates:[/b]
- Post Processing has been added.
- Small bug fixes. 
- Removing the report button. 
- New Levels.

GeoJelly has evolved, thanks to your incredible support and contributions. We're committed to continuing our journey with you, bringing even more exciting updates, features, and content to the game. We can't wait to see what new adventures await you as you explore GeoJelly beyond Early Access.

Thank you for your unwavering dedication and enthusiasm. Your feedback has shaped GeoJelly into the game it is today. Now, let's embark on this exciting new chapter together!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208040/GeoJelly/

Happy Exploring,
[b]The GeoJelly Team[/b]
[b]Source Byte Sp. z o.o.[/b]

notes.title: GAME FOR HARDCORES - GEOJELLY IS RELASING TODAY
notes.content:
🎮[b] Announcement: GeoJelly Now Available on Steam! [/b]🌍🍬

We are thrilled to announce that the long-awaited day has arrived! Today marks the official release of GeoJelly, an exciting new game developed by our dedicated team. After six months of tireless effort and creativity, we are delighted to bring GeoJelly to the Steam gaming community!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208040/GeoJelly/

🌟 [b]About GeoJelly[/b] 🌟

GeoJelly is an immersive and captivating adventure that will transport players to a mesmerizing world filled with vibrant colors, challenging puzzles, and delightful jelly creatures. Set in a unique and ever-changing landscape, players will embark on an epic journey through a series of mind-bending levels that will put their problem-solving skills to the test.

📣 [b]Get GeoJelly on Steam Today! [/b]🎉

The wait is over! GeoJelly is now available on Steam, ready to deliver countless hours of immersive gameplay and captivating challenges. We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to our dedicated team for their unwavering commitment and to our incredible community for their support and patience throughout the development process.

🌟 [b]Uncover the Secrets of the Dystopian Laboratory[/b] 🌟

GeoJelly thrusts you into a dystopian world, where you find yourself trapped within the mysterious depths of a foreboding laboratory. As a courageous and resilient being, you must navigate treacherous platforming levels, outsmart the intricate traps, and collect diamonds required to unlock your path to liberation.

⚡ [b]Master the Art of Timing and Precision [/b]⌛🎯

GeoJelly will put your prediction skills to the ultimate test. Prepare to embrace the game's unique mechanics, where your ability to hold the jump button will determine the length and height of your jumps. With each leap, consider the timing and distance carefully, for it is the key to surmounting the laboratory's diabolical challenges.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2208040/GeoJelly/

notes.title: GeoJelly - Another Rage Game - Hold To Jump
notes.content:
Join the escape adventure in GeoJelly! On February 6th at 10 AM PST, be a part of the Festival Next gaming event broadcast. Born as an experiment defect, navigate through treacherous platforming levels and avoid traps as you search for freedom. The simple yet captivating gameplay of holding to charge and letting go to jump will keep you hooked. Can you find your way out of the dystopian laboratory? Make sure to add GeoJelly to your Steam wishlist now, and join us for the exciting journey on February 6th. Don't miss out on the action!
